verse.verse_1: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise);
verse.verse_2: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).
verse.verse_3: For he who makes you angry (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)), - he will be cut off (from every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).
